verdict.rationale: Close documents creating leads via the REST API and an official MCP server with write scopes (mcp.write_safe). A Lead doubles as the company/account record, and custom fields and PUT-as-patch updates let an agent write company data onto it. However, nothing shows assigning an owner to a lead (the `assign_to` field applies only to phone numbers) or any built-in company-data enrichment source. missing for 10: documented lead owner/assignee field via API or MCP, built-in company data enrichment, MCP tool-level detail for lead creation, hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent flow.
